polozky.telo: Westminster, Colo., Sept. 9, 2026 — Trimble announced today the acquisition of Terasat Japan, one of the largest virtual reference station (VRS) service providers in the Japanese market. The acquisition allows Trimble to now directly offer its VRS correction service in Japan, providing significant incremental coverage for real-time, centimeter-level positioning for the geospatial, construction, automotive and agriculture industries. By providing a high-precision positioning foundation across Japan’s infrastructure, Trimble bridges the connection between digital models and the physical world. Financial terms were not disclosed. polozky.perex: Montreal, Canada, September 8th, 2026 – SimActive Inc. announces a new interactive mode in Correlator3D , designed to accelerate automated workflows.
polozky.telo: Montreal, Canada, September 8th, 2026 – SimActive Inc. announces a new interactive mode in Correlator3D , designed to accelerate automated workflows. Users can now run multiple scripts in succession within the same session, avoiding delays between operations and reducing total execution time. The feature is particularly useful for repetitive workflows involving several short scripts. Correlator3D remains ready for the next operation after each script is completed, making the overall process faster and more efficient.
